description: This file defines a templated C++ class `SingleClientServer` within the `WebSockets` namespace, which manages a WebSocket server intended for a single client. It includes methods to start and stop the server, and sets up external dependencies for WebSocket handling and logging.

classes.name: SingleClientServer<Derived>
classes.description: A templated class managing a WebSocket server for a single client, providing start and stop functionalities.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WebSocket server on a specified port, setting callback functions for connection setup and closure.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket server and the listening endpoint.
